AZUSA LIGHT & WATER
729 N. AZUSA AVENUE

FOLLOWING UTILITY BOARD MEETING
DATE AND TIME:
Monday, January 23, 2023
06:30 P.M.
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Azusa is hereby called to be held Monday, January 23, 2023 at 06:30 p.m. at AZUSA LIGHT & WATER.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
A.
PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
1.
Call to Order
2.
Roll Call
3.
Flag Salute
B.
PUBLIC COMMENT Please note that public comments are welcomed by recognition of the
Mayor, and are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda.
A Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption for up to three (3) minutes maximum time, only on items appearing on this agenda, and only if a vote is taken, in accordance with the Special Meeting Provisions of the Brown Act. Public Comment will be limited to thirty (30) minutes time
C.
CLOSED SESSION
1.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION - Significant Exposure to Litigation Pursuant to Paragraph (2) of Subdivision (d) of Government Code Section 54956.9 One Potential Case
Closed Session Report by the City Attorney
D.
SCHEDULED ITEM
1.
PUBLIC HEARING - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 2023-C06 FOR THE APPROVAL OF ELECTRIC FUND BUDGET AMENDMENT, APPROVAL OF CLIMATE FUND BUDGET AMENDMENT AND APPROVAL OF BLANKET PURCHASE ORDER INCREASE.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Conduct the Public Hearing and receive testimony;
2) Adopt Resolution No. 2023-C06;
3) Amend the Electric Fund Expense Budget for Fiscal Year 2022/23 for $10,550,000 for the purchase of wholesale power; and amend the GHG Fund Program Expense Budget for Fiscal Year 2022/23 in the amount of $950,000 for a total budget amendment of $11,500,000;
4) Amend the GHG Fund Program Revenue Budget for FY 2022/23 in the amount of $950,000; and
5) Approve an increase in blanket purchase order #037096: California Independent System Operator by $10,550,000.
D-1 Staff Report - Electric Fund Budget Amendment
E.
COUNCIL COMMENTS
F.
ADJOURNMENT
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
I, Adrian Garcia, MMC, Chief Deputy City Clerk of the City of Azusa, or my designee, hereby certify under penalty of perjury that a true, accurate copy of the foregoing agenda was posted on January 19, 2023, twenty-four (24) hours prior to the meeting per Government Code 54956 at the City Clerk's Office, 213 E. Foothill Blvd.; the lobby of the Police Department, 725 N. Alameda Ave.; the Civic Auditorium, 213 E. Foothill Blvd.; the City Library, 729 N. Dalton Ave.; and on the City's Web Page at www.ci.azusa.ca.us .
Adrian Garcia, MMC
Chief Deputy City Clerk
Azusa City Clerk's Office
